content: The Parable of the Sower
Noqw ép tāwat ep Jesus kīṅaqw yámakqe, wuhkovatuphat qalaveq qatuptu.
Noqw qaan’ewakw hintaqam sinom put aw tsovalti. Noqw ōviy pam pākihut aqw pákihqe pepeq qatuptu; noqw sinom sohsoyam pāhut qalavaqe hōñi.
Noqw pam tūtuwutsit akw pumuy hīhihta tutuqaynaqe amumi paṅqawu: Meh, hak tāqa uyto. Poshumit tsálakintaniqe pan uylawu.
Noqw pam uylawhq, pēhu poshumi pöhpava löhö; noqw masay’yuṅqam ökihqe, aṅ put soswa.
Noqw pēhu pik̇aqlöva qa pas pisay’taqat aṅ löhö; nihqe pay suhkuyva, aṅ tutskwa qa pȫṅalaniqw ōviy’o.
Nit tāwat yamakq, pay kólaki; noqw pay pi pam qa ṅay’yuṅqe ōviy aṅ tsakya.
Noqw pēhu kutqölpa löhö; noqw kūta aṅ kuyvaqe put lakna.
Noqw pēhu lolmat tutskwat aṅ löhökqe hihta aniwna; pēhu tsivót‐sikip sunat aw hóyokput aniwna, pu pēhu payhp sunát‐sikipo, pu pēhu sunat pakwt sihk̇ay’tasikipo.
Tuqayvastotaa! Pi uma naqvuy’yuṅwa.
The Purpose of the Parables
Noqw put aw nánatuwnayaqam put aw ökihqe, aw paṅqaqwa: Ya um hinoqw pumuy amumi tūtuwutsit akw yuaata?
Noqw pam lavayhtiqe amumi paṅqawu: Oveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatyat ahpiy navoti tupkiwta pew pahsavoo. Nīk̇aṅw pu’ hapi pam umumiwat susmataq’a; nīk̇aṅw ímuywatuy qatuptsiwni’yuṅqamuy amumi qa mahtaq’a.
Pi hihta himuy’taqat hapi aw piw noiwni; noqw pam hóyokiwtaqat himuy’tani; noqw pay ṅastanihqat hikis pi hihta himuy’taqw pam put aṅqw nawhkiwni.
Paniqw hapi ōviy nu pumuy amumi tūtuwutsit akw yuaata, puma as aw tayk̇ahk̇aṅw qa tutwaqw ōviy’o, pu tūqayk̇ahk̇aṅw qa nanapta, pu qa māmatsya.

Noqw pumuy hapi amuhpe Esaias nāt hintaniqa lavayiat aw antsaniwa. Ura pam Tutuyqawhqat eṅem yan lavayhti: Uma as aw tūqayk̇ahk̇aṅw nanaptat, qa māmatsyani; pu uma as aw tayk̇ahk̇aṅw tutwat, qa māmatsyani.

Pi imuy sinmuy unaṅwaam pās tunaiwyuṅwa, pu naqvuam qa nanvotya, pu puma uviyuṅwa, nāp hisat pi k̇a puma pōsiy akw tutwak̇aṅw, naqvuy akw nanaptak̇aṅw pu unaṅway akw māmatsye’, inumi ahoy nánamtök̇aqw, nu pumuy qalaptsinani, kita.
Nīk̇aṅw uma hapi hahlayhpit epya, ispi umuhposi tālat aw tāyuṅqw ōviy’o, piw umuhnaqvuy aṅ hötsíltoti.

Nu umumi pas antsa paṅqawni: Pas as k̇aysiwhqam Tutuyqawhqat lavay’aymatniqw, pu súanhinwisqam umuy hihta aw yórikyaqat as aw yórikyaniqey nānawaknak̇aṅw hapi qa aw yórikya, pu umuy hihta nanaptaqat as nanaptanik̇aṅw qa nanapta.
Jesus Explains the Parable of the Sower
Kurs huvam tuqayvastotaa. I’ tūwutsi hihta tuawi’taqat uma nanaptani.
Hak haqam moṅwtunatyat ahpiy lavayit navotk̇aṅw, put qa māmatsq, pahsat pay Nukpana aw pite’, put unaṅwpeq lavayit ūyiwhqat paṅqw ipwaṅwu. I’ hapi pöhpava yēvayaqat anta.
Pu i’ pik̇aqlöva yēvayaqa hapi it hakiy anta. Hak lavayit navote’, hahlayk̇aṅw āpiy put kwúsuṅwu.
Noqw pay lavayi hakiy unaṅwpeq qa ṅay’taqw, pay ōviy as pam hihsavo aṅ kuytaṅwu. Nīk̇aṅw ason lavayit ep k̇ānanvotpit, pu okiwsahsaniwuy aw pituqw, hihsavoniqw pay pam sóonhtiṅwu.

Pu i’ kutqölpa yēvayaqa hapi it hakiy anta. Hak lavayit as navotat, yep qatsit‐sa aw tunatyalte’, pu k̇āhakiwuy tuṅlay’k̇aṅw put akw ūnatiqe, soq lavayit qa aw tunatyaltiṅwu. Noqw ōviy lavayi put ahsonve qa hihta aniwnaṅwu.

Pu tuwat i’ lomatutskwat aṅ yēvayaqa hapi imuy amunta. Hakim lavayit nanapte’, māmatsyaṅwu. Noqw lavayi wuṅwe’, hihta aniwnaṅwu, pēhu tsivót‐sikip sunát‐sikip hóyokput himuy’vaya; pu pēhu payhp sunát‐sikipo, pu pēhu sunat pakwt sihk̇ay’tasikipo.
The Parable of the Weeds
Pu pam piw tūwutsit hihta tuawi’taqat akw pumuy tutuqaynaqe amumi paṅqawu: Oveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatya hapi hak pāsay aṅ lomavoshumit uyhqat anta.
Noqw pam puwhq, put tuwqaat pítuhqe, söhövosit amuhtsava söhövostusaqat uyht, ahpiy’o.
Noqw ūyi nahpi’vaqe talay’vaqw, pahsat pu söhövostusaqa piw mātaqti.
Noqw ōviy ki’taqat tumal’aymat put aw ökihqe, aw paṅqawu: Moṅwi, ya um as qa lomavoshumit uhpasay aṅ ūya? Noqw pam haqam söhövostusaqata?
Noqw pam pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Pay ituwqa panhti. Noqw tumal’aymat put aw paṅqaqwa: Noqw itam awye’, aṅ tsovalayaniqat um nāwakna?
Noqw pam pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Qae, taq k̇a uma söhövostusaqat aṅ tsovalantote’, söhövosit énaṅyani.

Pay pi hāk aṅ sohsoy wúṅwiwmani hisat tsovalaniwniqat aw pahsavoo. Noqw ason höqyaniqw, pep pu’ nu höqyaniqamuy amumi paṅqawni: Uma aṅ söhövostusaqat mohti tsovalayani, nen put somhtotat taqtsokyani; pu’ ason uma söhövosit ikoyohkiy aw taṅatotani.
The Parable of the Mustard Seed
Pu piw pas sukw tūwutsit akw amumi yuaaykuqe paṅqawu: Oveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatya mustard‐uyit sivosiyat anta. Put hak pāsay ep ūya.

Pam pas sohsok hihta pōvoshumit amuṅaqw sushihsay’o; nīk̇aṅw pam wuṅwe’, sohsok tusaqtsotskit amuhpenihqe suswuyoqtiṅwuniqe pas himutskiniwhtiṅwu. Noqw ōviy súmawuy aṅ masay’yuṅqam ök̇e’, put nantaqayat aṅ yesvaṅwu.
The Parable of the Yeast
Pu piw pam sukw tūwutsit akw pumuy amumi yuaaykuqe paṅqawu: Oveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatya pēk̇enit anta; put wuhti kwúsuhqe, payhp tuwanit ṅumnit enaṅ namiqwrilaṅwu; noqw pam sohsok put pēk̇enaṅwu.
Jesus’ Use of Parables
Iit yantaqat sohsok Jesus sinmuy amumi tūwutsit akw yuaata; nihqe pam tūwutsit qa akw yuaatanik, pay amumi qa yuaataṅwu.
Yan Tutuyqawhqat lavay’ayaat hin lavayhtiqa aw antsaniwa; pam ura paṅqawu: Nu tūwutsit hihta tuawi’taqat akw yuaatani; nu tūwaqatsit hisat yukiltiqat aṅqaqw hihta tupkiwyuṅqat paṅqawni.
Jesus Explains the Parable of the Weeds
Pahsat pu Jesus sinmuy aṅqe’ hōnat, kīmi paki. Noqw put aw nánatuwnayaqam aw ökihqe, aw paṅqaqwa: Um as söhövostusaqat hihta tuawi’taqat itamuy āawnani.
Noqw pam hu’waqe amumi paṅqawu: I’ lolmat poshumit uyhqa hapi nūu, Sinot Tíata.
Noqw pāsa hapi yep qatsi. Lomavoshumi hapi moṅwtunatyat aṅqw sinoiwtaqamu; noqw sohövostusaqa hapi hakiy qalolmat sinomatu.
Pu tuwqa, pumuy uyhqa hapi i’ Nukpana; yep qatsit so’ṅwamiq pituqw, pahsat pu höhöqsattiqat antani, noqw aṅ tsovalayaniqam hapi ōveqatsit aṅqw hoṅvia’yamu.
Noqw ōviy hapi söhövostusu tsovalaniwht, qȫhit akw taqtsokiwhq, pay pan hapi yep qatsit so’ṅwaveq hintani.
Nu Sinot Tiat ihoṅviaymuy ayataqw, puma imoṅwtunatyay aṅqw sohsokmuy lasnayaqamuy, pu qaanhinwisqamuy tsovalayani;
Nen pumuy qöpqömiq qȫhit aqw maspayani. Pep a’nö tsaykitiwni, pu tama ṅuritiwni.
Noqw pep pu’ hakim súanyuṅqam Nay moṅwtunatyayat ep tāwat an tālawṅway’yuṅwni. Tuqayvastotaa! Pi uma naqvuy’yuṅwa.
The Parable of the Hidden Treasure
Pu i’ pīwu: Oveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatya himu a’nö hihk̇ay’taqat pasve tupkiwtaqat anta. Put hak tāqa túwahqe, ahoy amht, put ep kwaṅwtoynaqe, ahpiynihqe sohsok hihta himuy húyahqe, put pāsat tui.
The Parable of the Pearl
Pu i’ pīwu: Oveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatya hakiy huhyaqat lolmat pearl hepnumqat anta.
Pam hak sūkw pearl pas a’nö hihk̇ay’taqat túwahqe, ahpiynihqe sohsok hihta himuy húyahqe, put tui.
The Parable of the Net
Pu i’ pīwu: Oveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatya pakiwmaktutsayat anta. Pam wuhkovatuphamiq tūviwhqe, sohsok hinyuṅqamuy pāvakiwhtuy inhta.
Put aw ohpokq, puma pāhut qalavoq put láṅaknayaqe, pep yesvat, pu aṅ nūnukṅwatuy pāvakiwhtuy hihta aqw taṅatotat, pu pay hin’ewakwmuy maspayaṅwu.
Noqw pan hapi hintani yep qatsit so’ṅwaveq’a. Oveqatsit aṅqw hoṅvia’yam nankwuse’, aṅ nūnukpantuy lomasinmuy amuṅaqw tsīk̇ayani,
Nen pumuy qöpqömiq qȫhit aqw maspayani. Pep a’nö tsaykitiwni, pu tama ṅuritiwni.
New and Old Treasures
Pu Jesus pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Ya uma īit sohsok māmatsya? Noqw puma aw paṅqaqwa: Owi, Tutuyqawhqa.

Noqw pam pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Sohsoyam tutuvenit tuwi’yuṅqam ōveqatsit aṅqw moṅwtunatyat ahpiy tutaqayhpit tuwi’vayaqam hapi hakiy k̇ahaktaqat anyuṅwa. Puma tutuvenit aṅqw hisattutuqayhpit sinmuy tutuqaynaya, pu pūhut tutuqayhpit pīwu.
Jesus Rejected at Nazareth
Noqw Jesus yan tutuqaynaqey yukut, paṅqw ahpiy’o.

Noqw pam nāp kitsókiy ep pítuhqe, pumuy tsotsvalkiyamuy aṅ pumuy tutuqayna. Noqw put aw tūqayyuṅqam aw k̇ātayyuṅqe, nātuviṅlalwaqe paṅqaqwa: Ya sen i’ haqaqw it wuwantuwit makiwa? Is uti, pu it k̇ātutmalat haqaqw öqalmakiwa?
Ya qa i’ wunavutsit tumaltuwi’taqat tíata? Ya yuat qa Mary yan mātsiwa, pu put tupkomat James‐niqw, pu Joses‐niqw, pu Simon‐niqw, pu Judas.
Pu siwamat, ya qa puma sohsoyam itamumya? Noqw ya sen i’ haqaqw īit hihta makiwa? kitota.
Nihqe puma put ep qaan’unaṅwtoti. Noqw Jesus pumuy amumi paṅqawu: Pay pi Tutuyqawhqat lavay’ayaat sohsovik k̇aptsi’tiwṅwu, hal pay nāp kitsókiy‐sa ep’e, pu pas nāp kiy ep pīwu.
Noqw puma qa tuptsiwni’yuṅqw, ōviy pay pam pep qa a’nö hihta tumalta.
